// ============================================================
// INPUT (demo).  👉 Change SAMPLE_INDEX to demo a different branch:
//   0 = clean, low value, known vendor   -> AUTO_APPROVED
//   1 = high value (>= threshold)        -> NEEDS_APPROVAL (human-in-the-loop)
//   2 = totals don't add up              -> REJECT_TO_MANUAL (deterministic catch)
//   3 = unknown / unlisted vendor        -> NEEDS_APPROVAL
// ============================================================
const SAMPLE_INDEX = 0;

const samples = [
  // 0 — clean, $371.70, ACME is on the allowlist  => AUTO_APPROVED
  ["ACME OFFICE SUPPLIES",
   "Invoice #: INV-2041",
   "Date: 2026-05-28",
   "Bill To: Rocketium Pvt Ltd",
   "-----------------------------------------",
   "Qty  Description              Unit     Amount",
   "2    Ergonomic chair          120.00   240.00",
   "5    Notebook (pack of 5)       8.00    40.00",
   "1    Standing desk mat         35.00    35.00",
   "-----------------------------------------",
   "Subtotal: 315.00",
   "Tax (18%): 56.70",
   "TOTAL DUE: USD 371.70",
   "Payment terms: Net 30"].join("\n"),

  // 1 — $10,680 (>= 5000 threshold), DELL is on the allowlist => NEEDS_APPROVAL
  ["DELL TECHNOLOGIES",
   "Invoice Number INV-99812",
   "Invoice Date: 2026-05-30",
   "Customer: Rocketium Pvt Ltd",
   "Item                       Qty   Rate       Line Total",
   "Latitude 7440 Laptop         6   1450.00    8700.00",
   "USB-C Dock                   6    180.00    1080.00",
   "3yr ProSupport               6    150.00     900.00",
   "Subtotal                                   10680.00",
   "Tax (0%)                                        0.00",
   "Amount Payable: USD 10680.00",
   "Terms: Net 45"].join("\n"),

  // 2 — line items + tax = 670 but stated total says 970 => REJECT_TO_MANUAL
  ["BRIGHT PRINT CO",
   "INV: BP-5567   Dated 2026-05-22",
   "To: Rocketium Pvt Ltd",
   "Description               Qty    Price   Total",
   "Brochure printing (A4)    1000    0.45   450.00",
   "Lamination                1000    0.10   100.00",
   "Design setup fee             1   75.00    75.00",
   "Subtotal:  625.00",
   "Tax:        45.00",
   "GRAND TOTAL: USD 970.00"].join("\n"),

  // 3 — maths fine, $3,079.80 (< threshold) but NIMBUS not on allowlist => NEEDS_APPROVAL
  ["NIMBUS CLOUD SERVICES",
   "Invoice #: NB-3310",
   "Date: 2026-06-01",
   "Bill To: Rocketium Pvt Ltd",
   "Service                         Amount",
   "Managed Kubernetes (May)        2200.00",
   "Egress + storage overage         410.00",
   "Subtotal                        2610.00",
   "Tax (18%)                        469.80",
   "TOTAL: USD 3079.80",
   "Terms: Net 15"].join("\n")
];

const idx = Math.min(Math.max(SAMPLE_INDEX, 0), samples.length - 1);
const invoiceText = samples[idx];

// Build the extraction prompt here (plain JS string -> no {{ }} clashes).
const extractionPrompt = [
  "You are an invoice DATA-EXTRACTION agent. Read the raw invoice text and return",
  "ONLY a valid minified JSON object (no markdown fences, no commentary) with EXACTLY these keys:",
  '{"vendor_name":"string","invoice_number":"string","invoice_date":"YYYY-MM-DD or empty","currency":"3-letter ISO e.g. USD","line_items":[{"description":"string","quantity":0,"unit_price":0,"amount":0}],"subtotal":0,"tax":0,"stated_total":0,"extraction_confidence":0}',
  "",
  "RULES:",
  "- Copy every number EXACTLY as printed. Do NOT recompute, correct, or 'fix' any totals.",
  "  If the invoice maths looks wrong, still report stated_total exactly as printed.",
  "  (A separate deterministic step verifies the arithmetic.)",
  "- Missing field => \"\" for strings, 0 for numbers, [] for line_items.",
  "- extraction_confidence (0..1) = how sure you are this text was a parseable invoice.",
  "",
  "RAW INVOICE TEXT:",
  invoiceText
].join("\n");

return [{
  json: {
    invoiceText,
    extractionPrompt,
    source: "manual-demo",
    sampleIndex: idx,
    receivedAt: "2026-06-04T00:00:00.000Z"   // fixed for a reproducible demo
  }
}];

parameters.content:
## 🧾 Invoice Review & Approval
### Agentic n8n workflow

**AI extracts → code validates → router decides → human approves the risky ones.**

**▶ To run:** open `📄 Sample Invoice`, set `SAMPLE_INDEX` (0–3), then click **Test workflow**.

**Needs only an OpenAI credential** on the two `OpenAI Model` nodes. The Gmail + Google Sheets nodes are **disabled** (they pass data through) — enable them + add credentials for live email approval & ledger logging.

### 🤖 AI #1 · Extraction
Messy invoice text → structured JSON. The LLM is told **not** to do arithmetic.

### 🧮 Deterministic core (NO AI)
Re-computes every total, checks currency / vendor allowlist / threshold, and **decides the route**.

### 🤖 AI #2 · Risk review
Summarises the risk for the human approver. Skipped for auto-approved & rejected items.

### 🔌 Integrations + Human-in-the-loop (disabled by default)
Gmail send-&-wait = human approval. Google Sheets = audit ledger. Enable + add credentials for live use.
